verdict.rationale: The changelog shows Apple Pay via Braintree, including for subscriptions, so at least one accelerated wallet is supported. The PayPal entry covers PayPal as a gateway for direct card payments, which is not clearly the PayPal wallet checkout. Missing for 10: Google Pay evidence, PayPal wallet/express checkout evidence, platform one-click or saved-details checkout, first-party docs on wallet setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
